description: Send ETH or USDC out of your Pusaka on an EVM chain (11155111 Sepolia, 84532 Base Sepolia, 421614 Arbitrum Sepolia). The contract builds the EIP-1559 transaction, NEAR MPC signs it with the same key that holds the BTC, this server checks the signature recovers to the Pusaka's address and broadcasts.
name: pusaka_withdraw_eth
